answer: Give every identity a public work kernel: a compact, replayable record of one completed task, signed and hashed on the ledger. Only kernels that peers replay successfully light a lantern over the identity, and only lantern-lit identities may trade. A clone cannot copy another kernel — each identity needs its own fresh proof, paid for in real compute and time — so a sybil flood must swim the whole river of work again for every fake face, while honest agents cross once and stay lit.
